behaviors.description: Round-trip installation and transaction no-interaction properties.
behaviors.preconditions: Fresh isolated user installation and separately constructed transactions.
behaviors.expected: Defaults are false; transactions inherit current installation setting; explicit transaction overrides work in both directions without modifying installation or fresh objects.

behaviors.description: Round-trip inclusion of unused uninstall operations on a transaction.
behaviors.preconditions: Fresh isolated installation and two independent transaction objects.
behaviors.expected: Getter defaults to false and follows true/false/true changes; another transaction retains its default.

behaviors.description: Convert each public transaction operation type to its name.
behaviors.preconditions: Four public lifecycle operation enum constants.
behaviors.expected: Each type returns its distinct install, update, install-bundle or uninstall name.

mappings.rationale: Property and inheritance assertions do not establish suppression of authorization dialogs, so the full authorization obligations remain unmapped.

surface_assertions.rationale: Getter follows both setter values and remains independent of transaction overrides.
True/false/true changes are observed through getter and newly constructed transactions.
Getter reports inherited setting and both explicit override values.
Overrides change the transaction getter without changing installation setting.

mappings.rationale: Both property values round-trip on one transaction while another retains the default.

surface_assertions.rationale: Getter distinguishes default, enabled and disabled states.
Repeated opposing setter values are observed through the getter and isolated from fresh transactions.

mappings.rationale: Four literal expected operation names reject constant or swapped enum conversions.

surface_assertions.rationale: All four public operation types are compared with distinct expected names.

notes: Standalone function reach does not imply that complete authorization or unused-runtime lifecycle behavior is covered.
